Kensington is best known as a maker of laptop docks, locks, and computer accessories. Their VeriMark line is a fingerprint biometric FIDO2 family with strong Windows Hello integration and a refresh announced in 2026. The VeriMark Guard 2.1 is the portable security key, while the VeriMark IT 2.0 and VeriMark Desktop 2.0 are biometric readers aimed at fixed workstations rather than portable use.
